items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know that Eureka has a record out of Blue Collar and he's Ace's only. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Ace Watson. That was the first one I'd named. That was the best Marshall ever had.
You ever see his picture on that record they have out? Yeah. You know that Eureka has a record out of Blue Collar and he's Ace's only.
